h1: Jiruspon Mansion — a small, quiet mansion near Burapha U, Bangsaen, on an easy budget
intro: Not everyone who comes to Bangsaen wants a beachfront hotel with a pool · some people just want a clean, quiet room near Burapha University at a price they can afford, whether for a night or a month — and that is exactly where Jiruspon Mansion places itself · it's a small mansion of just 15 rooms, tucked on a lane off Bangsaen Sai 4 Tai Road in Saen Suk, only a few hundred metres from the Burapha University gate · the air-conditioned rooms come fully furnished with a fridge, water heater, work desk, and balcony, plus free Wi-Fi and free parking · daily rates start around THB 700–800 and monthly rates around THB 3,700–4,800 · this is also a small place with very few OTA reviews, so we're telling it straight from the real information we could find, without inflating the numbers

body.html: Who Jiruspon Mansion is for, in short — first, let's be straight: Jiruspon Mansion is not a beachfront tourist hotel with a pool, spa, or fancy lobby · it's a small mansion and apartment building with just 15 rooms, built for people who want a "place to live" more than a "place to holiday" · from what shows up across several channels, this place positions itself among the university-area stays, only a few hundred metres from the Burapha University gate, so it suits students looking for a monthly room, parents visiting for a short stay, and workers who need to be in the Chonburi-Bangsaen area regularly · another good fit is people coming for an event or activity at the university who want a stay close to the venue at a budget they can control · if you're a tourist who's set on swimming at Bangsaen Beach, eating seafood by the sea, and walking straight from your room to the sand, this may not be your answer, because the mansion sits deep on a lane and is a fair way from the beach · but if your goal is a clean, quiet, safe room with parking that doesn't cost much — especially over several nights or a month — Jiruspon Mansion is a reasonable choice in this area

Location and getting around — Jiruspon Mansion is at 43/1 Bangsaen Sai 4 Tai Road, Saen Suk, Mueang Chon Buri · the biggest draw of the location is how close it is to Burapha University, only about 600 metres away, or a few minutes' walk · the Bangsaen Sai 4 area is a residential and student-dorm zone, so there are made-to-order eateries, convenience stores, coffee shops, laundries, and student-priced food spots scattered all around, which makes daily life easy without travelling far · for sightseeing, Bangsaen Beach, Central Plaza Chonburi, and Nong Mon Market are about a 10 min drive away if you have a car or hail a ride, and other spots like Khao Sam Muk and the Institute of Marine Science aren't far either · the thing we have to say clearly is that the mansion sits deep on a lane and isn't beachfront — some guest reviews say outright that it's on a "deep lane and not near the sea," so if you don't have a car, getting to the beach or the mall means relying on a motorbike taxi or a ride-hail, and you should budget for those trips too · for longer travel, Suvarnabhumi Airport is about 70-some kilometres away, roughly an hour-plus drive

"The place is on a deep lane, not by the sea, but the room is fine, clean, the owner takes good care of you, and they provided a shuttle to the event venue — it suits people coming for business or an event at the university more than coming straight for the beach."

Room types and the fit-out — Jiruspon Mansion is a mansion building with a lift, with around 15 rooms in total · the rooms are air-conditioned studios that come fully furnished, about 25 sqm, which is just right for one or two people · the property lists a bed, work desk, wardrobe, air conditioner, fridge, a TV with cable/satellite, water heater, and a private balcony · many rooms have a balcony for some fresh air or to hang laundry · the fit-out leans on simple, practical dorm-mansion style — not flashy design, but clean and fully functional · the point guests speak well of is that the rooms are clean and comfortable, fully furnished and move-in ready, without needing to buy much extra, which suits people settling in for a long stay · since this is a small place designed more for residential living than tourist hotels, what you shouldn't expect is full hotel service such as 24-hour room service or daily housekeeping like a big hotel · we'd suggest asking the property directly about room details and what is or isn't included before booking, especially for a monthly stay

Facilities and common areas — even as a small mansion, Jiruspon Mansion has a fair set of the basics you need for living · there's free Wi-Fi and LAN, which matters a lot for students and workers who need to study or join online meetings · on security, there's CCTV, a key-card entry system, and 24-hour security, which helps parents feel easier about sending their kids to stay · there's a lift that makes carrying things up easy · for laundry, there's a coin-operated washing machine and a drinking-water dispenser in the common area · parking is an advantage, with free car and motorbike parking, which is hard to find in a dorm area where parking is often a struggle · there's also a terrace, a luggage-storage service, and a front desk open during limited hours · what's not here, and worth knowing from the start, is that this place has no pool, no gym, no spa, and no pets allowed · if those are what you want, look for a hotel or resort on Bangsaen Beach instead, but if you just want a clean, safe place with internet and parking, Jiruspon Mansion delivers those essentials at an easy price

Food and eating around the property — Jiruspon Mansion is a residential mansion, so it doesn't have a restaurant or in-house breakfast like a tourist hotel · but that's barely an issue given the location, since it sits right in the middle of the Burapha University student-dorm area, which is famous for budget eats · within a short walk or drive there are made-to-order eateries, curry-rice shops, noodle stalls, coffee shops, milk-tea stands, 24-hour convenience stores, and late-night food spots that cater to students · for people who like to cook, the rooms have a fridge and some have enough space for a small food-prep corner, which makes a long, thrifty stay genuinely workable · if you want seafood with a seaside vibe, it's about a 10 min drive to Bangsaen Beach or Nong Mon Market, with plenty of Chonburi's well-known souvenirs and snacks to choose from · overall, food isn't a weak point here, because the university-area location easily makes up for the lack of an in-house restaurant — and it's cheaper than eating in a hotel, too

Service and care — as a small, owner-run place, the strength that tends to win guests over is its friendliness and attentive care · voices from past guests say the welcome is good, the owner and team help out with various things as reasonable, and in some cases where people stayed for a university event, there was even a shuttle service to the event venue — a small detail that leaves a good impression · that said, because it's a small mansion, the front desk is open only during limited hours and doesn't have staff on duty 24 hours like a big hotel · so if you arrive late or have a special need, such as early check-in or late check-out, you should contact the property ahead of time so they can sort it out in time · booking direct or asking by phone usually gives more updated and flexible information than tapping through an app alone, especially for a monthly stay

Voices from real reviews (praise and gripes) — to be straight for transparency, Jiruspon Mansion is a small place with very few reviews on online booking platforms · some platforms are still "awaiting reviews" and others have only a handful, so the score you see isn't an average from a large crowd and should be read with some judgement · on the praise side, as far as it shows: rooms are clean and comfortable, fully furnished and move-in ready, the welcome and care are good and friendly, the price is good value especially against a long stay, there's free parking and security features like key-cards and CCTV, and the location near Burapha University is handy for study and errands · on the watch-out side: the thing mentioned most clearly is that the location is on a deep lane and not beachfront, so it doesn't suit people whose main aim is the beach and who don't have a car · on top of that, because it's a small place, hotel-style facilities (pool, gym, in-house restaurant, 24-hour service) aren't here, and the room-availability/price info in apps may not be as current as asking directly · in short, if you set your expectations to match what this place is — a budget residential mansion near the university, not a holiday hotel — the chance of disappointment is very low

"Clean room, fully furnished, move-in ready, very friendly on price if you stay long · the only catch is that without your own car it's a bit of a hassle getting to the beach or the mall — you have to hail a ride."

Price and value compared — Jiruspon Mansion's main selling point is a genuinely affordable price · for a daily stay it starts around THB 700–800 per night, which is very cheap compared with beachfront tourist hotels in Bangsaen that usually start in the mid-thousands and up · for a monthly stay it's around THB 3,700–4,800 per month (not including metered water and electricity — in this area, electricity is generally around 7 baht/unit and water around 35 baht/unit) · worked out per night for a long stay, the price drops a lot further, which makes it best value when you stay by the week or month · compared with other dorms or mansions in the Bangsaen Sai 4 area at similar prices, Jiruspon Mansion has the edge with full furnishing, a lift, and free parking · but if you measure value from the angle of a tourist staying just 1–2 nights for the beach, the value drops because you have to add the cost of getting to and from the beach and the mall · put simply: the longer you stay, the better the value, and the more you have a car, the more convenient it is

Good to know before booking — a few things help you decide and check in more smoothly · one, since it's a small place with few online reviews, we suggest you contact the property directly (there's a phone number in the property's listings) to check availability, current prices, and the most up-to-date daily/monthly terms · two, if you'll stay monthly, ask clearly about water and electricity charges, the deposit, and the contract, since they're billed separately from the room · three, the place is on a deep lane and not beachfront, so if you don't have your own car, budget for trips to the beach/mall and download a ride-hail app · four, confirm check-in time (generally 2:00 PM) and check-out (before 12:00 PM), and if you arrive outside front-desk hours, let them know ahead · five, an extra bed costs more (about 300 baht/night), and pets aren't allowed here · six, if you want certainty on refunds, choose a free-cancellation option when booking through a platform

Wrap-up — Jiruspon Mansion is a small, quiet mansion for people who want a "place to live" near Burapha University on an easy budget, more than a beachfront holiday hotel · if you're a student looking for a monthly room, a parent visiting your child, a worker who needs to be in Bangsaen regularly, or someone coming for a university event who wants a nearby stay at a good price — this place meets that need well, with fully furnished rooms, security that's looked after, free parking, and a location that makes daily life easy · but if your main aim is the Bangsaen beach, you want to walk to the sand, have a pool, and full hotel service, this isn't the right pick, and you should consider a hotel or boutique resort on Bangsaen Beach instead · most importantly, because it's a small place with few online reviews, we always recommend asking the property directly about details and prices before you decide, so you get the most accurate and current information
